summary: Reproduced the four chunk-dependent Qwen3 reasoning-parser outputs on the recorded base, confirmed that the base still pinned the divergence as accepted behavior, and inspected the directly related open upstream candidate PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35085. The correction splits at the first opening marker, routes preceding text as content unless reasoning was already forced open, and buffers a trailing partial opening marker across streaming chunks. Regression coverage makes streaming chunk sizes agree with one-shot parsing and adds leading-newline, force_reasoning, and incomplete-marker boundary cases. Source: /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/parser/reasoning_parser.py. No native source or library is involved.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and regression are deterministic string routing in the CPU-only reasoning parser and do not execute a model, compiler, kernel, or GPU path; using the assigned gfx950 would not provide issue-specific evidence.
